title: CONTROL OF RFID DATA EXCHANGE
abstract: An active RFID device (20), method and system for controlling data exchange between RFID tag reader/writer devices and passive or semi-active RFID devices (10) associated with said active RFID device (20); said RFID tag reader/writer devices having an associated data exchange means (30) for exchanging data with passive or semi-active RFID devices (10); said data exchange means (30) being arranged to provide authentication data indicative of the RFID tag reader/writer devices with which they are associated; and said active RFID device (20) comprising means for enabling exchange of data between said passive or semi-active RFID devices (10) and the RFID tag reader/writer devices with which said data exchange means (30) is associated in accordance with an applicable access policy for that RFID tag reader/writer device.
